## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector returns (Energy, Technology, Materials positive vs Healthcare, Communication, Financials negative) and leadership concentrated in Tech — Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy leads: SLB (1W: +6.63% | 1M: +8.21%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +1.69% | 1M: -8.79%) RECOVERY, CVX (1W: +0.66% | 1M: -9.72%) RECOVERY.  
Technology leads: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +3.27% | 1M: +16.56%) ABOVE TREND.  
Materials showing strength: NUE (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +30.18%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +8.60% | 1M: -2.42%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: -13.05% | 1M: +7.17%) CORRECTION.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Communication weak: CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +13.47%) CORRECTION.  
Healthcare weak: JNJ (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND, DHR (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND.  
Consumer Discretionary lagging pockets: TSLA (1W: -6.07% | 1M: -2.50%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -3.87% | 1M: +1.02%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, NUE (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +30.18%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: COF (1W: -7.30% | 1M: +3.33%) CORRECTION, IBM (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -3.90%) BELOW TREND, HON (1W: -8.73% | 1M: -5.59%) BELOW TREND, DHR (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -9.76% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Top 1W movers: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND; watch QCOM (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present (≥3 large caps with 1W ≠ 1M: META, JPM, V, MA) — watch for trend break and dispersion.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed but tilted positive; several chip names leading while large-cap software shows two-speed action. AAPL (1W: +0.31% | 1M: +7.30%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +14.44%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +3.27% | 1M: +16.56%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -3.90%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth: Tech is one of 5/11 sectors positive.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials showing short-term weakness with mid-term positives — many names in CORRECTION. JPM (1W: -0.65% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION, COF (1W: -7.30% | 1M: +3.33%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +1.48%) CORRECTION — breadth: Financials negative this week (part of 6/11 sectors not positive).

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Sector is soft with notable dispersion: UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND is a clear outlier versus broader weakness. JNJ (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -3.53%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth: Healthcare among the 6/11 not positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor selective exposure to strong tech chip names (AMD, INTC, TXN) and high-conviction cyclicals showing strength (NUE, SLB, UNH); reduce exposure to beaten defensive and comms names (CHTR, TMO, IBM). Style: Growth-leaning but narrow leadership — be selective given the dispersion and major divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -17.74%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Technology (leadership in chips) and Energy (positive 1W activity); breadth: 5/11 overall positive.  
BEARISH: Healthcare and Communication — watch for continuing underperformance and sentiment-driven moves.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA 1M: watch continuation above near-term breakout (NVDA (1W: +3.27% | 1M: +16.56%) ABOVE TREND).  
AMD support area to defend recent gains (AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND).  
UNH breakout level to confirm further upside (UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND).  
CHTR downside risk for broader Communication pullback (CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
UNP (+55): Union Pacific (1W: +6.99% | 1M: +11.34%) ABOVE TREND — bullish headline confirmed by strong price action.  
HON (+55): Honeywell (1W: -8.73% | 1M: -5.59%) BELOW TREND — positive restructuring headlines but price is diverging (distribution risk).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
PFE (-50): Pfizer (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.03%) BELOW TREND — price action confirms negative headlines.  
ABBV (-60): AbbVie flagged by negative FDA headline; price data not in this extract — monitor for confirmation or divergence before action.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, growth-leaning given narrow Tech leadership.  
AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: major divergence across large caps (META CORRECTION, JPM CORRECTION) and sentiment-driven mismatches (HON headlines vs BELOW TREND price) — monitor for trend confirmation.
